mapper.select: SELECT id, username, nickname, email, phone, avatar_url, gender, status, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM users
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users(username, password, nickname, email, phone, avatar_url, gender, status) VALUES(#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{avatarUrl}, #{gender}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET username = #{username}, nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, gender = #{gender}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
